name: outlook
description: Read-only access to local classic Outlook mail and calendar via COM, saving an email to the knowledge base when you ask for it. Windows only; requires pywin32.

kb_dir.title: Knowledge-base folder
kb_dir.description: Where an email is saved as Markdown when you ask for it to be kept, for the knowledge-base plugin to index (blacklisted messages are never written). Reading an email does NOT save it. Keep this inside that plugin's documents folder (C:\Eva\knowledge) or saved mail is never indexed. Enter 'off' to forbid saving, after which this server writes no local file at all.

search_folders.title: Search folders
search_folders.description: Optional. Comma-separated folder names for outlook_search_recent, e.g. 'Inbox,Sent Items,Archive'.

blacklist_file.title: Blacklist file
blacklist_file.description: Optional. Path to a file of extra content-blacklist terms, one per line.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Absolute path to the python.exe that has this server's pip dependencies installed (e.g. C:\Python311\python.exe). Use plain 'python' only if the right interpreter is first on PATH - a mismatch here is the most common cause of 'dependency missing' errors.
